title: Designing Conversational AI to Support Think-Aloud Practice in Technical Interview Preparation for CS Students

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative evaluation through thematic analysis of user interviews and AI feedback, specifically observing how the AI interviewer misinterprets non-native English speakers' communication styles and use of apologies as a lack of technical confidence or uncertainty.

Qualitative observation and analysis of female participants' mock interview simulations, noting how the AI evaluates and potentially penalizes gender-socialized communication habits, such as a higher frequency of apologizing during technical explanations.
